entities.name: Flooding of Terisiare
entities.description: Event over several decades after the World Spell in which retreating glaciers flooded Terisiare.

entities.name: Terisiare
entities.description: Continent of Dominaria flooded after the glaciers retreated.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane affected by the World Spell.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: Event after which glaciers gripped Terisiare.

entities.name: Sea of Laments
entities.description: Sea formed in the middle of Terisiare.

entities.name: Shattered Sea
entities.description: Sea that rose over sinking lands.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Yavimaya's being who made peace with the survivors.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Land the Fyndhorn survivors fled to.

entities.name: Krov
entities.description: Plague-infested, vampire-ridden city swallowed by the Shattered Sea.

entities.name: School of the Unseen
entities.description: Ruined school that fell beneath the waves.

entities.name: Tirras
entities.description: Land whose population exploded after the flash floods.

events.summary: The four glaciers of Terisiare retreat and vanish, freeing meltwaters.
events.quote: The now sudden retreat and gradual disappearance of these glaciers

events.summary: The Sea of Laments forms and splits Terisiare into islands.
events.quote: splitting the continent apart into smaller islands

events.summary: Jaeuhl Carthalion and Kaysa lead Fyndhorn survivors to Yavimaya and make peace with Multani.
events.quote: led the Fyndhorn survivors to Yavimaya

events.summary: The Shattered Sea swallows the city of Krov.
events.quote: eventually also swallowed the plague-infested, vampire-ridden city of Krov

events.summary: Iwset and Jehesic are scoured away, and the School of the Unseen site falls beneath the waves.
events.quote: although it had already been ruined and abandoned by this time

events.summary: Flash floods nearly wipe out the hill tribes of Tirras, whose land turns fertile.
events.quote: Almost wiped out in flash floods

relations.quote: made peace with Multani and the intelligent gorillas there
